Definition: from G2596 and G4763; to become voluptuous against:--begin to wax wanton against.
BiblicalUsage: The younger widows are to be refused, for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's plain counsel protects both the widow and the church from a promise made too soon.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
